meta.name: bedtime-story
meta.description: 为3-12岁儿童提供温馨亲切的睡前寓言故事和成语典故讲解。支持用户唤醒后提供故事列表选择，或直接讲解指定故事/成语。讲解时保持亲切温馨的语气、0.6倍正常语速、通俗易懂的表达，为小朋友营造舒适的睡前氛围。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为3-12岁儿童讲述温馨的睡前故事和成语典故
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果家里有3-12岁孩子，需要每晚讲睡前故事。
copy.tagline_en: Tell warm bedtime stories and idiom tales for children aged 3-12
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have kids aged 3-12 and need bedtime stories every night.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会化身温柔的睡前故事家，为 3-12 岁儿童讲解寓言故事和成语典故。它用 0.6 倍语速、亲切温馨的语气和通俗易懂的短句，全文讲解，并在开头和结尾加上温馨的致意。
howto.when: 当孩子或家长说“我要听故事”、报出具体故事名或成语（如“守株待兔”）、或发送故事序号时触发。

say.note: 会生成 20 个寓言故事列表让你选。
会讲解成语典故、含义和例句。
会全文讲解《龟兔赛跑》的故事。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a gentle bedtime storyteller for children aged 3-12. It narrates fables and idiom stories in a warm, slow voice (0.6x speed), with simple short sentences and full-text tellings, plus warm opening and closing phrases.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says 'I want to hear a story', names a specific story or idiom (e.g., 'waiting by the stump'), or sends a story number.

say_en.text: I want to hear a story
say_en.note: Shows a list of 20 fables to pick from.

say_en.text: Tell me about 'waiting by the stump'
say_en.note: Explains the idiom's background, meaning, and example.

say_en.text: Tell me the tortoise and the hare
say_en.note: Tells the full story of the fable.
